needs.what: the Planechase subsystem (rule 901): a planar deck per game, a face-up plane or phenomenon in the command zone, and a `planeswalk` op (701.31) that puts the current plane on the bottom of the planar deck and turns over the next one, firing its "When you planeswalk to/away from" triggers; wrapped in `may` for "you may planeswalk"
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No op, zone object or game setup in the reference knows planes, phenomena or a planar deck; `planeswalk` appears nowhere in `ops`, and the Planeswalker-related keys (`or_planeswalker`, `must_attack_planeswalker`) are about the card type, not the Planechase action. The rest of the card is expressible: Flying as a keyword, Crew 2 as `tap_permanents` with `total_power: 2`, the attack trigger with a Time Lord `exists` condition, and 'the next spell you cast this turn has cascade' as a once_this_turn `delayed_trigger` on spell_cast with a `cascade` effect
